mapper.sql: SELECT b.bill_id,b.prj_id,b.bill_stts_cd,b.amnd_yn,b.orgnl_bill_id FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.prj_id FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: SELECT b.bill_id,b.bill_stg_id,false AS virtual_plan,b.bill_no,b.prj_id, p.prj_nm AS project_name,p.cust_ptnr_id AS customer_id,c.ptnr_nm AS customer_name, p.cntrct_ty_cd AS contract_type,b.atrb_ym,b.bill_dt::text AS bill_dt, b.sply_amt,b.vat_amt,b.tot_amt,b.bill_stts_cd,b.txinv_no,b.txinv_dt::text AS txinv_dt, b.rcpt_plan_dt::text AS rcpt_plan_dt, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.rcpt_amt) FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=b.bill_id),0) AS received_amt, b.tot_amt + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.tot_amt) FROM bill.bill a WHERE a.orgnl_bill_id=b.bill_id AND a.amnd_yn='Y' AND a.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM'),0) AS adjusted_total_amt, CASE WHEN b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' THEN b.tot_amt + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.tot_amt) FROM bill.bill a WHERE a.orgnl_bill_id=b.bill_id AND a.amnd_yn='Y' AND a.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM'),0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.rcpt_amt) FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=b.bill_id),0) ELSE 0 END AS receivable_amt FROM bill.bill b JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=b.prj_id LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=p.cust_ptnr_id
mapper.select: WHERE b.orgnl_bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY b.bill_dt NULLS LAST,b.bill_id

SELECT d.asgn_id,a.dev_id,d.cntrct_dev_id,v.dev_nm AS display_name,d.work_ym, d.mm_qty,m.mm_qty AS source_mm_qty,d.untprc_amt,d.work_day_qty,d.work_tm_qty, d.ovtm_tm_qty,d.ovtm_amt,d.bill_amt,d.rmrk_desc FROM bill.bill_dtl d LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.asgn_id=d.asgn_id LEFT JOIN mst.dev v ON v.dev_id=COALESCE(d.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=d.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=d.work_ym WHERE d.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY d.bill_dtl_id

SELECT h.data_chg_ty_cd AS description, to_char(h.chg_at,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') AS changed_at,h.chg_user_id::text AS user_id FROM sys.data_chg_hist h WHERE (h.tbl_nm='bill.bill' AND h.obj_rec_id=CAST(#{id} AS text)) OR (CASE WHEN h.tbl_nm='bill.rcpt' THEN COALESCE(h.bfr_val,h.aft_val)::jsonb ->> 'bill_id' END = CAST(#{id} AS text)) ORDER BY h.chg_at DESC,h.data_chg_hist_id DESC
mapper.sql: SELECT r.rcpt_id AS receipt_id,r.rcpt_dt,r.rcpt_amt,r.rmrk_desc FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_ym=#{month}
mapper.update: UPDATE bill.rcpt SET rcpt_dt=#{row.rcpt_dt},rcpt_amt=#{row.rcpt_amt},rmrk_desc=#{row.rmrk_desc} WHERE bill_id=#{id} AND rcpt_id=#{row.receipt_id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bill.rcpt WHERE bill_id=#{id} AND rcpt_id=#{receiptId}
